title: File System Watcher Hookup
requirements: ListViewModel holds a private FileSystemWatcher initialized with the diary output folder URL; no longer a stand-alone never-instantiated class
Subscribe to FileSystemWatcher.events: AsyncStream<URL> in ListViewModel via a stored Task; on each debounced emission, call await refresh()
Add a teardown() / stop() method on ListViewModel that cancels the subscription Task; invoke from ContentView .onDisappear (or .task cancellation)
Wire the existing toolbar Refresh button to refresh() as before — the watcher is additive, not a replacement
Debouncing must collapse burst writes (10 files in 1s) to at most 2 refresh events (file-system-watcher contract)
acceptance_criteria: Dropping a new .m4a into the diary folder (with a matching manifest row side-loaded) causes the timeline to update within ~2 seconds without a manual refresh
Closing ContentView cancels the watcher subscription Task (no leaked subscription)
Burst writes do not cause more than 2 refresh events per burst window
